record_type_quote: For the replication study, the 2011 survey rather than the 1998 ECLS-K survey was used so this is an entirely new dataset with entirely new subjects.

targets.title: School Support, Parental Involvement, and Academic and Social Emotional Outcomes for English Language Learners.
targets.evidence_quote: The claim selected for replication from Niehaus & Adelson (2014) is as follows: It is likely that ELL (English language learner) children’s social-emotional difficulties are related to their academic difficulties in the classroom.
targets.outcome_quote: Thus the replication claim was successful according to the SCORE criteria.
targets.outcome_reasoning: An explicit overall success verdict is supported by the reported negative significant association in a new survey cohort.
